prompt: Who starred in a movie about the subject of a song on the compilation album "Friends and Relatives," and also played themselves on an episode of "Friends"?
answer: Robin Williams — he starred in *Popeye* (1980), about the character who is the subject of the song “Popeye the Sailor Man,” and appeared as himself on *Friends* in “The One with the Ultimate Fighting Champion.”
